description: Searchable, categorized, cross-linked glossary that progressively enhances a definition list

attributes.name: data-title
attributes.description: Glossary heading, rendered as a real heading (the title attribute is not used). Observed.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL to JSON term data: { title?, terms: [{ id, term, definition, category?, seeAlso?, definitionHtml? }] }. Fetched once per URL; an inline <dl> renders as the fallback while loading and if the fetch fails. Observed.

attributes.name: searchable
attributes.description: Adds a search input (inside a <search> landmark) that filters terms by name and definition. Observed.

attributes.name: data-state
attributes.description: Set in src mode: loading while fetching, ready after the data renders, error when the fetch fails (an error message is shown and the fallback <dl> is kept).

attributes.name: data-label-search
attributes.description: Accessible name of the search input.

attributes.name: data-label-terms
attributes.description: Accessible name of the terms region.

attributes.name: data-label-alphabet
attributes.description: Accessible name of the jump-bar nav.

attributes.name: data-label-found-one
attributes.description: Search announcement for the Intl.PluralRules "one" category ({count} is replaced). Any category works: data-label-found-few, -many, -zero, -two.

attributes.name: data-label-found-other
attributes.description: Search announcement for the "other" category and the fallback for unset categories.

attributes.name: data-label-all-one
attributes.description: Announcement when the search is cleared ("one" category; other categories as for found).

attributes.name: data-label-all-other
attributes.description: Announcement when the search is cleared ("other" category and fallback).

attributes.name: data-label-uncategorized
attributes.description: Category label for terms without data-category.

attributes.name: data-label-see-also
attributes.description: Prefix for seeAlso links generated from JSON / .terms data.

attributes.name: data-label-error
attributes.default: Could not load the glossary terms.
attributes.description: Message shown when src fails to load.

childAttributes.name: data-term-id
childAttributes.description: Unique term identifier, set as the div's id (fragment anchor). Jump-bar letters link to the first term of each letter.

structure.description: Source definition list (optional with src: rendered as the fallback). Kept in place, hidden, while upgraded; restored on teardown.
One per term inside the dl, wrapping its dt and dd

properties.name: terms
properties.type: Array<{ id, term, definition, category?, seeAlso?, definitionHtml? }>
properties.description: Get the parsed terms ({ id, term, definition, category, seeAlso? }; definition is text), or assign to rebuild. Assigned entries are written into the source <dl>, so they survive moves and re-renders. definition is rendered as text; definitionHtml is an explicit opt-in passed through VB's HTML sanitizer.

events.name: glossary-wc:ready
events.description: After every render (upgrade, reconnect, observed attribute change, .terms assignment, src load). Not fired while src is loading.

events.name: glossary-wc:search
events.description: After the (debounced) search input is applied

events.name: glossary-wc:terms-changed
events.description: After .terms assignment (fires after the render's ready)

events.name: glossary-wc:error
events.description: When src fails to load (HTTP error, invalid JSON, or no terms array)
